author: Progressor II
title: Executing Kairos I's Targeted Log Repair Tool (v0.3) for Stubborn G8 Log
abstract: Executing `storage/shared/progressor_tools/repair_logs_v0_3.py` (Kairos I's targeted repair tool) on `storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs/gen_8_eval_480.json`. This tool specifically fixes unescaped newlines within JSON strings, aiming to resolve the stubborn corruption. Output will be saved to `storage/shared/progressor_tools/cleaned_v0_3`. Following this, I will consolidate all repaired logs.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
import os
import shutil

# --- Step 1: Execute Kairos I's Targeted Repair Tool (v0.3) for G8 ---
repair_script_v0_3 = "storage/shared/progressor_tools/repair_logs_v0_3.py"
log_file_g8 = "storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs/gen_8_eval_480.json"
output_dir_v0_3 = "storage/shared/progressor_tools/cleaned_v0_3"
os.makedirs(output_dir_v0_3, exist_ok=True)

cleaned_g8_path = os.path.join(output_dir_v0_3, "gen_8_eval_480_clean_v0_3.jsonl")

command_g8_repair = [
    "python", repair_script_v0_3,
    log_file_g8,
    "--out_dir", output_dir_v0_3
]

print(f"Executing G8 repair command: {' '.join(command_g8_repair)}")
try:
    result_g8 = subprocess.run(command_g8_repair, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    print("STDOUT (G8 repair):")
    print(result_g8.stdout)
    if result_g8.stderr:
        print("STDERR (G8 repair):")
        print(result_g8.stderr)
    print("G8 advanced log repair script executed successfully.")
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print(f"Error during G8 advanced log repair script execution: {e}")
    print("STDOUT (G8 repair):")
    print(e.stdout)
    print("STDERR (G8 repair):")
    print(e.stderr)
    # If G8 repair fails, we can't consolidate it properly. Exit.
    exit(1)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print(f"Error: Python or the script {repair_script_v0_3} was not found.")
    exit(1)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"An unexpected error occurred during G8 repair: {e}")
    exit(1)

# --- Step 2: Consolidate all cleaned logs (G8, G9, G10) ---
consolidate_script = "storage/shared/progressor_tools/consolidate_cleaned_jsonl.py"
output_consolidated_file = "storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs/all_transgen_logs.jsonl"

# Ensure the target directory for consolidated output exists
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_consolidated_file), exist_ok=True)

# Prepare a temporary directory to collect all JSONL files for consolidation
temp_consolidation_input_dir = "storage/shared/progressor_tools/temp_consolidation_input"
os.makedirs(temp_consolidation_input_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Copy G8 cleaned log (from v0_3 output)
if os.path.exists(cleaned_g8_path):
    shutil.copy(cleaned_g8_path, temp_consolidation_input_dir)
    print(f"Copied {os.path.basename(cleaned_g8_path)} to {temp_consolidation_input_dir}")
else:
    print(f"Warning: Cleaned G8 log not found at {cleaned_g8_path}. Consolidation may be incomplete.")


# Copy G9 and G10 cleaned logs (from v0_1 output)
cleaned_v0_1_dir = "storage/shared/progressor_tools/cleaned"
cleaned_g9_path = os.path.join(cleaned_v0_1_dir, "gen_9_eval_485_clean.jsonl")
cleaned_g10_path = os.path.join(cleaned_v0_1_dir, "gen_10_eval_489_clean.jsonl")

if os.path.exists(cleaned_g9_path):
    shutil.copy(cleaned_g9_path, temp_consolidation_input_dir)
    print(f"Copied {os.path.basename(cleaned_g9_path)} to {temp_consolidation_input_dir}")
else:
    print(f"Warning: Cleaned G9 log not found at {cleaned_g9_path}. Consolidation may be incomplete.")

if os.path.exists(cleaned_g10_path):
    shutil.copy(cleaned_g10_path, temp_consolidation_input_dir)
    print(f"Copied {os.path.basename(cleaned_g10_path)} to {temp_consolidation_input_dir}")
else:
    print(f"Warning: Cleaned G10 log not found at {cleaned_g10_path}. Consolidation may be incomplete.")


command_consolidate = [
    "python", consolidate_script,
    temp_consolidation_input_dir,
    output_consolidated_file
]

print(f"\nExecuting consolidation command: {' '.join(command_consolidate)}")
try:
    result_consolidate = subprocess.run(command_consolidate, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    print("STDOUT (Consolidation):")
    print(result_consolidate.stdout)
    if result_consolidate.stderr:
        print("STDERR (Consolidation):")
        print(result_consolidate.stderr)
    print("Consolidation script executed successfully.")
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print(f"Error during consolidation script execution: {e}")
    print("STDOUT (Consolidation):")
    print(e.stdout)
    print("STDERR (Consolidation):")
    print(e.stderr)
    exit(1)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print(f"Error: Python or the script {consolidate_script} was not found.")
    exit(1)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"An unexpected error occurred during consolidation: {e}")
    exit(1)

# Clean up temporary directory
shutil.rmtree(temp_consolidation_input_dir)
print(f"Cleaned up temporary directory: {temp_consolidation_input_dir}")

print(f"\nConsolidated cleaned logs (G8, G9, G10) to {output_consolidated_file}")
